# Homestead Seoul (홈스테이드 서울)

## About
Homestead Seoul is a clean, affordable private guesthouse in Bangbae-dong, Seocho-gu, Seoul, South Korea.
Address: 서울특별시 서초구 방배동 911-14

## Who We Serve
- Budget international travelers visiting Seoul
- Korean commuters seeking short or monthly stays
- Digital nomads, students, and business travelers

## Room Features
- Private en-suite bathroom
- Air conditioning
- Work desk and wardrobe
- In-room laundry support
- High-speed internet

## Location Highlights
- About 1-2 minutes on foot to Bangbae Station (Line 2)
- Around 15-20 minutes to Gangnam area (depending on route/time)
- Practical access to major Seoul areas including Myeongdong and Jamsil
- Easy transfer options via nearby Sadang routes

## Booking and Contact
- KakaoTalk: https://open.kakao.com/o/replace-me

## Pricing
- Typical short stay: from KRW 45,000/night
- Typical monthly stay: from KRW 650,000/month
- Final rate depends on room type, availability, and stay length

## Language
- Korean (primary)
- English (supported)
